title: Brain Development Timeline
description: Interactive graph of typical versus ADHD prefrontal development from age 4 to 25, with a draggable age cursor reading concrete percentages and the age-equivalent gap, clickable life-stage markers, and a demand-line overlay showing the struggle zone.
creator: Arun Batchu
subject: ADHD
Brain Development
Neurodevelopmental Disorder
Maturation Lag
audience: People with ADHD, Family members, Students, Educators
